# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Revalidated the biofilter-scaling review feedback and found the equal absolute nitrifier seeding fix was already present on HEAD. This pass applied the remaining probe correction by changing the no-clearance fallback in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs` to judge the larger filter on lower total reduced nitrogen plus no-worse nitrite, instead of requiring lower TAN specifically under an equal-seed setup. The habitat geometry probe suite now passes end to end.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the biofilter probe against the review finding, confirmed the fixed absolute-seeding path was already present, and isolated the remaining mismatch to the fallback assertion used when neither run clears reduced nitrogen within the horizon.
2. [Completed] Updated the no-clearance fallback assertion/message in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs` so the larger-media branch is evaluated on lower total reduced N and no-worse NO2 rather than a stricter lower-TAN requirement that no longer matches the equal-seed setup.
3. [Completed] Ran formatting plus targeted habitat-probe validation, then a broader `tank_harness` test sweep to confirm the biofilter probe fix and capture the remaining unrelated shrimp-probe failures in the dirty worktree.

## Validation Evidence

- `git diff -- crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs`
- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_harness`
- `git status --short`
- `git diff --stat -- crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs`

## Outstanding Risks

- `cargo test -p tank_harness` still fails in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs::{probe_successful_breeding, all_shrimp_probes_summary}` due unrelated dirty-tree changes already present in that file; I did not modify or reconcile those edits in this pass.
